text:
devon: Heads-up — scope onboarding interactive tour shows an empty "effective permissions" preview for some tenants. Seen on prod and staging this morning.

maria-design: Hmm, is that the modal where you can pick example routes? Can you paste steps to repro?

devon: Steps: 1) Org admin -> Console -> Roles -> Onboard tour -> step 3 (preview). 2) Click 'Pick example route' dropdown -> empty. Seen on tenant `acme-qa` and `acme-prod`.

alex-engineering: I dug into network trace — the frontend calls `GET /api/orgs/{org}/example-routes` and gets 204 for acme-prod. Should be 200 + [] at minimum.

console-bot: deploy-notify: New frontend release deployed to staging at 2025-11-02T07:12Z (sha: fe2b9).

sara-pm: Impact: onboarding tour is a major first-run flow for enterprise trials. If admins can't preview routes, they'll likely drop off. Marking P2 but UX-sensitive.

ryan-enginfra: Possible quick fix: treat 204 as empty list in the client to avoid blocking the dropdown. Long-term we should fix the API to return `[]` not 204. Can we do a small client patch today?

maria-design: If we show an empty state we should add microcopy: "No example routes found for your org — try creating a route or select from global examples." Would prefer not to surface raw empty dropdown.

devon: I can open a tiny PR for the client shim (treat 204 as []). Also filing ticket: https://issues.internal.redwood/PLT-1228 — includes trace and screenshots.

alex-engineering: Assign the API ticket to backend infra — I suspect permission filter incorrectly returns 204 when query has no visibility. I'll take the client PR and wire a canary to 10% of traffic.

ryan-enginfra: Can we also add a short telemetry event for this case? `onboarding.example_routes.empty_state` with org_id and source (=global|tenant). Helps decide rollout.

maria-design: +1 for telemetry. Also add a flag `ui.showGlobalExamples` so we can toggle showing curated global ones while API fix ships.

devon: Created PR: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/frontend/pulls/458 — small guard that converts 204 -> [] and renders the empty copy. Canary planned.

alex-engineering: Thanks. I'll follow up on the backend ticket and link the telemetry schema. If anyone sees other tenants with this, drop them here.

maria-design: Thanks team, will add copy to copy repo and mock for mobile. :thumbsup:
